queries: site.microsoft.com investor FY 2025 Q3 earnings AI business annual revenue run rate 13 billion April 2025

sources_considered.why: Primary source establishes what the January announcement actually measured.
Read the transcript. Its Azure growth contribution is a different metric and cannot directly establish the total AI revenue run rate.
Its year-over-year run-rate comparison permits an explicit calculation of the March 2025 historical base.

evidence_items.locator: Satya Nadella quotation in the opening earnings-release section

receipt.public_excerpt:
Already, our AI business has surpassed an annual revenue run rate
of $13 billion, up 175% year-over-year.

evidence_items.explanation: The January release described an achieved annualized run rate, not projected revenue for the whole of 2025. This earlier-period disclosure supplies context, not a target-quarter outcome.

metric_scope.metric: AI business annual revenue run rate

evidence_items.locator: Satya Nadella quotation in the opening earnings-release section

receipt.public_excerpt: Our AI business surpassed an annual revenue run rate of $37 billion, up 123% year-over-year.

evidence_items.explanation: The disclosed year-over-year comparison implies a March 2025 run rate of approximately $16.6 billion or more. This is historical evidence about the target quarter, not an argument that growth in a later period disproves an earlier stall.

metric_scope.metric: AI business annual revenue run rate

inputs: March 2026 annual revenue run rate surpassed $37 billion
derived.formula: Implied March 2025 run rate = March 2026 run rate / (1 + 1.23); 37 / 2.23 = 16.5919 billion dollars per year.
derived.rounding: Approximately $16.6 billion; not an exact value because the revenue threshold and growth percentage are rounded.

unresolved_gaps: The research does not disprove the narrower assertion that Microsoft had published no updated absolute run-rate figure between January and June 30.
The historical run rate is inferred from a later comparable growth disclosure rather than directly reported as a March 2025 dollar figure.
